name: Carlos R Moraes Rodrigues
tagline: DevOps and Platform Engineering backed by a strong software engineering foundation
summary: Software engineer with more than 20 years of experience, including the last five years working directly on critical systems and production AWS infrastructure. His backend background evolved into DevOps and Platform Engineering through legacy application modernization, operational automation and the delivery of more reliable environments.
positioning: Investigates issues across applications, runtimes, containers, Linux, networking, observability and cloud infrastructure.
Combines hands-on execution, technical leadership, risk management and clear operational communication.
technicalFoundation: More than two decades building and sustaining web systems provide the foundation for platform decisions grounded in real application needs.
atsCallout: Two-page Portuguese PDF optimized for recruitment systems.

experience.role: Senior Developer — working in DevOps and Platform Engineering
experience.body: Work focused on critical systems, AWS infrastructure, application modernization and evolution of the container platform.
bullets: Operates and evolves production AWS infrastructure with EC2, RDS, S3, VPC, EFS, IAM and CloudWatch.
Built and operates a Docker Swarm platform; evolved the edge to ALB, ACM and Traefik distributed across three Availability Zones.
Led the modernization of legacy PHP applications into containerized workloads with Nginx, WAF, queues, schedulers, secrets and health checks.
Implemented observability with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and Alloy, including dashboards, alerts and runbooks.
Diagnosed unwanted inter-AZ traffic and validated a reduction greater than 99%; inventoried and classified more than 100 AWS resources for governance and FinOps.
Automates deployments and operations with Terraform, Python, Bash and Bitbucket Pipelines while documenting changes and risks.

experience.body: Developed and sustained corporate web applications, integrations and legacy systems for institutional clients.
bullets: Worked with PHP, Laravel, Drupal, APIs and integration services.
Supported critical applications in Linux environments for legislative institutions.

experience.body: Developed and maintained web applications with PHP, JavaScript, relational databases and Linux while balancing independent projects with continued study of Clean Code, Design Patterns, architecture and automated testing.
Developed and sustained internal corporate and self-service systems with PHP, CodeIgniter and PostgreSQL.
Developed web applications and corporate systems with Microsoft .NET and PHP for financial services, industrial and retail clients.

projects.name: Distributed Systems Lab
projects.body: Author-led educational channel organized into multiple series and evolving seasons. The published first season contains 10 episodes on manually building the foundation of a Docker Swarm lab on AWS, progressing from EC2 and port-based publishing to a stack with WAF, domain, Traefik and TLS. It includes a complementary quiz created with Quick Quiz, whose administrative tool uses OpenAI to generate and translate questions on demand.
